description: This file contains a series of shell test scripts for verifying different options and behaviors of the 'git pull' command, including cases with various flags, configurations, and error conditions. It primarily sets up git repositories, executes 'git pull' with different parameters, and checks the output and state to validate functionality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the given commands within the test context.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that a specified command produces no output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches within output for specific patterns.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates commits in a repository, optionally with specific message or options.

methods.name: test_ref_missing
methods.description: Checks that a reference does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specific file or directory does not exist.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Defines cleanup actions to run after the test completes.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up hooks for testing specific git behaviors.
